title: F. Lee Bailey on the CIA's Index 4 during the McCord case
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of F. Lee Bailey on the CIA's Index 4 during the McCord case, about 1973 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Well, it was Bailey. It was Bailey himself because Bailey, it turns out, was on index 4 for the agency.

plain: Dan Sheehan, a lawyer, says that in 1973 in Washington, during the case of James McCord, one of the Watergate burglars, he found out that the famous defense lawyer F. Lee Bailey was on what he calls the CIA's Index 4, apparently a list of people working with the spy agency. Sheehan tells it as someone who was involved, and it would mean the CIA had a hand on the defence side of the case.
